items.title: FDA approves Abbott's Amplatzer Paraclose, which the company calls the first US transcatheter device designed to close paravalvular leaks around surgical valves
items.summary: On Oct 28, 2026, Abbott announced FDA approval of the Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder, which it describes as the first and only US-approved transcatheter device specifically designed to close paravalvular leak (PVL) around surgical replacement heart valves, as an alternative to repeat open-heart surgery.
bullets: **FDA approved the Abbott Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder** (announced **28 Oct 2026**), which Abbott calls the **first US transcatheter device designed for paravalvular leak (PVL)**.
**PVL** is backflow around a **surgical replacement valve**; it occurs in **7-17% of mitral** and **5-10% of aortic** valve replacements.
It can cause **heart-failure symptoms** and **haemolysis with severe anaemia**.
The **oblong (elliptical) occluder** is delivered by catheter through a **leg artery or vein** and placed within the leak.
Approval rests on **PARADIGM**: **prospective, multicentre, single-arm, 200 patients**; the release gives **no efficacy or safety figures**.
Outside the US it is the **Amplatzer Valvular Plug III**, approved in **Europe since 2020**.
Caveat: **single-arm** data, no randomised comparison with surgery; leaks after **TAVI** are not mentioned.
